t: 法国军队从奥地利和勃兰登堡击败了军队.
te: The French army defeats forces from Austria and Brandenburg.
dz: 科尔马尔战役:法国军队从奥地利和勃兰登堡击败了军队.
de: Battle of Colmar: The French army defeats forces from Austria and Brandenburg.

t: 约翰·弗拉姆斯泰德被任命为第一位英国皇家天文学家.
te: John Flamsteed is appointed the first Astronomer Royal of England.
dz: 约翰·弗拉姆斯泰德被任命为第一位英国皇家天文学家.
de: John Flamsteed is appointed the first Astronomer Royal of England.

t: 神圣罗马帝国军队在孔泽尔·布吕克战役中击败了法军.
te: Forces of the Holy Roman Empire defeat the French in the Battle of Konzer Brücke.
dz: 法荷战争:神圣罗马帝国军队在孔泽尔·布吕克战役中击败了法军.
de: Franco-Dutch War: Forces of the Holy Roman Empire defeat the French in the Battle of Konzer Brücke.

t: 约翰三世·索比耶斯基手下的波兰-立陶宛军队在卢瓦尔战役中击败了奥斯曼-塔塔尔军队.
te: A Polish-Lithuanian army under John III Sobieski defeats an Ottoman-Tartar army in the battle of Lwow.
dz: 约翰三世·索比耶斯基手下的波兰-立陶宛军队在卢瓦尔战役中击败了奥斯曼-塔塔尔军队.
de: A Polish-Lithuanian army under John III Sobieski defeats an Ottoman-Tartar army in the battle of Lwow.

t: Leibniz首先使用长 s (∫)作为微积分中组成部分的符号.
te: Leibniz makes the first use of the long s (∫) as a symbol of the integral in calculus.
dz: Leibniz首先使用长 s (∫)作为微积分中组成部分的符号.
de: Leibniz makes the first use of the long s (∫) as a symbol of the integral in calculus.

t: 普利茅斯殖民地总督约西亚·温斯洛(Josiah Winslow)在腓特烈国王之战期间带领一支殖…
te: Plymouth Colony governor Josiah Winslow leads a colonial militia against the Narragansett during King Philip's War.
dz: 普利茅斯殖民地总督约西亚·温斯洛(Josiah Winslow)在腓特烈国王之战期间带领一支殖民民兵来对抗纳拉干斯特人.
de: Plymouth Colony governor Josiah Winslow leads a colonial militia against the Narragansett during King Philip's War.

t: Gottfried Leibniz首次演示了整体微积分,以找到Y=Q(x)图下的区域.
te: Gottfried Leibniz demonstrates integral calculus for the first time to find the area under the graph of y = ƒ(x).
dz: Gottfried Leibniz首次演示了整体微积分,以找到Y=Q(x)图下的区域.
de: Gottfried Leibniz demonstrates integral calculus for the first time to find the area under the graph of y = ƒ(x).

t: 安东尼奥·德·韦亚探险队从巴塔哥尼亚西部的圣拉斐尔湖入驻.
te: Antonio de Vea expedition enters San Rafael Lake in western Patagonia.
dz: 安东尼奥·德·韦亚探险队从巴塔哥尼亚西部的圣拉斐尔湖入驻.
de: Antonio de Vea expedition enters San Rafael Lake in western Patagonia.

t: "大沼泽之战"(英语:The Great Wamp Fight)是腓特烈国王之战中的关键战役,…
te: The Great Swamp Fight, a pivotal battle in King Philip's War, gives the English settlers a bitterly won victory.
dz: "大沼泽之战"(英语:The Great Wamp Fight)是腓特烈国王之战中的关键战役,使英国定居者获得了惨烈的胜利.
de: The Great Swamp Fight, a pivotal battle in King Philip's War, gives the English settlers a bitterly won victory.
